decoded.scope: Arbitrary paired 135-bit current state and arbitrary common inputs. Includes every next-state bit and all3 outputs. Initial-state sets match under relation (71 zeros,64 unspecified RAM read bits); no claim of same powerup trace for independent choices of the unspecified bits.

coverage.clock: every formal transition is one rising SCK edge; all state clocks audited equal SCK, positive polarity
coverage.final_read: 31 registered samples plus final MISO = 32 bits
limitations: bounded exact protocol schedule, not all-sequence equivalence
functional digital model only; no analog/timing or board-programming claim
no independent specification of computed output, only equality between artifacts
